classes.description: The model is not called per request. A cache hit, a static lookup, an embedding search. Reuse of a precomputed answer. The O(1) of AI.
classes.headline: The model is not called per request.
classes.name: Constant

classes.description: Deterministic code shrinks the input before the model sees it. The class most organizations miss entirely. RAG done right; code is the new cache layer. Published results: SQL views shrinking clinical data from ~240,000 tokens to 19,000 before the model is called, and retrieval pipelines eliminating better than 99.9 percent of a million-token corpus.
classes.fix: Filter and retrieve before inference, not after.
classes.headline: Deterministic code shrinks the input before the model sees it.
classes.name: Sublinear

classes.description: One model call per request, cost proportional to input size. Summarize, answer, translate. The healthy default, and what most budgets implicitly assume. Watch for fixed per-call overhead from large tool catalogs.
classes.fix: Trim per-call overhead; keep this the default.
classes.headline: One model call per request, cost proportional to input size.
classes.name: Linear

classes.description: k model calls per request, and k is usually invisible. Extended thinking can burn over a hundred thousand tokens per request while producing a few hundred visible ones. Non-composable tools that replay full context each turn can make a five-step chain cost 10 to 20x the composed version.
classes.fix: Compose tool pipelines; instrument for hidden k.
classes.headline: k model calls per request, and k is usually invisible.
classes.name: Multiplicative

classes.description: An orchestrator spawns sub-agents that spawn tool calls. The O(n²) of AI: architecturally powerful, economically dangerous if unmonitored. The danger is not delegation; it is unbounded depth and unscoped context running unwatched.
classes.fix: Bound agent depth; add circuit breakers and budgets.
classes.headline: An orchestrator spawns sub-agents that spawn tool calls.
classes.name: Agent-multiplicative

classes.description: Loops with no termination condition. Retry-on-failure with no cap, recursive self-rewriting. The infinite loops of the token economy, and they exist today in production systems that lack circuit breakers.
classes.fix: Hard termination conditions and circuit breakers. Always.
classes.headline: Loops with no termination condition.
classes.name: Unbounded

expansion: requests × model calls per request × agent depth

variables.description: Covers two things that often move together: how many requests hit the workload, and how large each request's input is. Either or both can be the scaling dimension.
variables.name: Requests, or input size

variables.description: Reasoning steps, multi-turn chains, tool calls that replay context. The trap: k is usually invisible. It rarely appears in the request itself.
variables.name: Model calls per request

variables.description: Sub-agents calling sub-agents. An orchestrator spawning workers multiplies everything above it in the tree.
variables.name: Agent depth
